_comment: The Instagram strip's data source. Hand-written today; written by a fetch
script later. The shape is deliberately the shape of Meta's /me/media
response so that swapping one for the other is a script, not a rebuild.
1. Save the image into public/assets/insta/ (square crops look best).
2. Add an entry below. Newest first — the strip renders in array order.
"caption": "One line. Shown on hover and read by screen readers." }
WHY `image` IS A LOCAL PATH AND NOT THE API'S media_url
media_url is a SIGNED CDN link and it expires. Storing it would make the
strip work for a while and then silently go blank, which is the worst
possible failure because nothing errors. The fetch script must download
each image into this folder and write the local path here.
EMPTY IS A VALID STATE. With no posts the section still renders its one
card inviting people to Instagram, which is the point of the section.
